data.curated_T_max.spec: longest per-series annual evaluation length on the curated panel; max `T_annual` of mcs_monthly_resolution.csv

data.curated_T_min.spec: shortest per-series annual evaluation length on the curated panel; min `T_annual` of mcs_monthly_resolution.csv. This is the quantity the propositions in the k* section are stated at, and it is what every pooled result conditions on

data.curated_candidates.spec: size of the PRE-COMMITTED candidate universe screened for the curated panel; number of entries in breadth_manifest_distinct.json, the decision log breadth_fetch.py writes at fetch time. The denominator that makes the panel size meaningful: 12 of this many, not 12 chosen freely

data.curated_dropped.cross_check: breadth_manifest_distinct.json: sorted series with status != PASS
data.curated_dropped.spec: candidates screened OUT of the curated panel, sorted and ';'-joined; entries in breadth_manifest_distinct.json with status != PASS (DROP, or a fetch failure). Emitted so the paper reports its exclusions by name rather than only its inclusions -- a selection rule stated without its casualties is not checkable

data.curated_metrics.spec: the accuracy metrics each curated series is scored on, sorted and ';'-joined; the distinct `metric` of social_choice.csv. The panel's cell count is the product of this and the series count, so the two must be stated from the same source

data.curated_models.spec: the forecasting models entered on the curated panel, sorted and ';'-joined; the distinct `model` of breadth_distinct_predictions.csv. Recorded from the artifact rather than from run_multiseries.MODELS, which resolves from the environment and describes what would run now rather than what ran

data.curated_n_models.spec: size of the curated panel's model pool; distinct `model` of breadth_distinct_predictions.csv

data.curated_rebase_tol.spec: the rebasing tolerance a candidate had to meet to enter the curated panel: the real-time/realized ratio at the 2005-01-01 probe had to sit within this fraction of 1, screening out rebased indices in favour of natural-unit levels; `criteria.rebase_tol` of breadth_manifest_distinct.json

data.curated_series.spec: identifiers of the curated panel, sorted and ';'-joined; the distinct `series` of breadth_distinct_predictions.csv, the frozen loss matrix every curated result is scored from

data.curated_vintage_cutoff.spec: the ALFRED vintage-depth criterion a candidate had to meet to enter the curated panel; `criteria.vintages_cover` of breadth_manifest_distinct.json. Pre-committed before results were seen, and chosen so the 2008 recession is reconstructable in real time

data.curated_year_max.spec: last evaluation year on the curated panel; max `year` of breadth_distinct_predictions.csv. Emitted alone, WITHOUT a matching first year: the panel's series begin in several different years, so a single minimum would state an envelope as though it were uniform. The per-series evaluation LENGTH carries that information honestly and is emitted instead

data.flagship_contrast_models.spec: models carried on the flagship window-inversion exhibit, sorted and ';'-joined; the index of contrast_exhibit.csv. A strict subset of the scoreboard tier, which is why the rank denominator quoted from this exhibit differs from the scoreboard's pool size

data.flagship_scoreboard_models.spec: models entered on the flagship claims series, sorted and ';'-joined; the columns of extension_scoreboard_1988-2025.csv. Named for its TIER: the flagship is scored on two frozen artifacts with different pools, and an unqualified key would not say which

data.flagship_year_max.spec: last evaluation year on the flagship series; max index of extension_scoreboard_1988-2025.csv

data.flagship_year_min.spec: first evaluation year on the flagship series; min index of extension_scoreboard_1988-2025.csv. Unlike the curated panel this is a single series, so a first year is uniform by construction and states no envelope

cites: S3.6 body: window-vs-basis attribution -- short-window leg
flagship.ar1_rank_short_window_revised.cross_check: extension_scoreboard_1988-2025.csv: rank of ar1 in mean over years >= 2011
flagship.ar1_rank_short_window_revised.spec: AR1's rank by pooled MASE on the REVISED-basis record restricted to the exhibit's own short window (2011-2025), over the exhibit's model set. Holds the forecast basis fixed while the window varies, which the frozen exhibit does not: read against flagship.ar1_rank_long_window (same basis, long window) to attribute the inversion to the WINDOW rather than to the real-time-vs-revised convention
